articles.summary: International condemnation of Houthis no longer enough, says senior Yemeni official A senior official in Yemen’s Saudi-backed government said on Sunday that condemning Houthi attacks on civilians is no longer enough and the world must now turn to firm action. “It is no longer acceptable for regional and international condemnations of the targeting of civilians and civilian infrastructure to remain mere verbal stances, without being translated into firm measures that achieve accountability and deterrence,” the vice president of Yemen’s Presidential Leadership Council, Abdullah al-Alimi Baw

articles.title: Inside Italy's Changing Politics and Papacy
articles.summary: New York Times Correspondent and Former Rome Bureau Chief Jason Horowitz tells Bloomberg This Weekend how his 25 years reporting from Italy gave him a firsthand view of the Vatican, papal transitions and the country's evolving political landscape. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Horowitz discusses his new memoir, The Italian Job, and how Italy's political experiments, from Silvio Berlusconi to Giorgia Meloni, offer insights into broader global trends. (Source: Bloomberg)
